results.title: OpenAI will embed third-party evaluators; critics say the program falls short : NPR
results.content:
The company announced Monday that staff from four AI safety and research organizations will become "embedded assessors" to "give people a clearer view of how labs are evaluating and managing [potential] risks."

"Getting an outside opinion on the safety work and the robustness of these systems is going to be increasingly important and valuable," CEO Sam Altman said at Semafor's Silicon Valley and the World conference on Monday. [...] Accessibility links

OpenAI will embed third-party evaluators; critics say the program falls short OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said he would grant "employee level" access to outside researchers to evaluate AI safety. The pilot program appears much more restrictive.

photo of OpenAI's logo on a black screen [...] "Embedded auditing will only fulfill its aims if the auditors really get employee-level access as opposed to being hired to do a specific job," he posted on X in response to OpenAI's announcement. "Sadly, OpenAI makes it clear now that [Sam Altman's] September tweet about 'employee-like access' was just an awkward overpromise that the company wants to quietly walk back."
